items.title: The comparison map between pullback and the right adjoint is an isomorphism for a proper flat finite presentation morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme Y and a proper flat finite presentation morphism f : X -> Y, the lemma asserts that the map of equation labelled equation-compare-with-pullback is an isomorphism for every object K of D_QCoh(O_Y) (statement lines 2891-2917). By Lemma labelled lemma-proper-flat the functor a commutes with direct sums, so the collection of objects for which the comparison map is an isomorphism is a strictly full, saturated, triangulated subcategory preserved by direct sums (proof lines 2919-2929). Since D_QCoh(O_Y) is a module category by Derived Categories of Schemes, Theorem labelled perfect-theorem-DQCoh-is-Ddga and is generated by a single perfect object by Derived Categories of Schemes, Theorem labelled perfect-theorem-bondal-van-den-Bergh, one argues as in More on Algebra, Remark labelled more-algebra-remark-P-resolution that it suffices to check the map on one perfect object, where it holds by Lemma labelled lemma-compare-with-pullback-perfect (proof lines 2929-2935). Reducing the general statement to a generating perfect object by closure properties of the isomorphism locus is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
